title: EXX layer is wrong at a large scale
symptom: Large-range EXX-KS deviations or scrambled EXX bands after localization.
evidence_required: fullcoul construction method and its parameters

candidate_experiments.action: inspect the Coulomb matrix for non-Hermiticity and negative eigenvalues
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: confirms or excludes a broken fullcoul before touching any threshold
candidate_experiments.guard: record the findings in the trial ledger

candidate_experiments.action: cross-check the fullcoul construction with the other algorithm
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: separates a construction bug from a basis or screening problem
candidate_experiments.guard: direct methods need converged ecut/kz/gamma orders and have no automatic fallback

stop_condition: fullcoul passes both algorithms and the EXX anomaly persists (continue with r3).
